name: uxrintake
description: The UXR Intake Assistant — a guided front door for UX research requests.

plugins.name: uxr-intake
plugins.description: Guided UX research intake. Opens with a menu so you can choose what you want out of it: sharpen and challenge your question, find out what research already exists, have an interface reviewed, or get a finished ticket — and stop after any block once you have what you need. Sharpens a research question, recommends a rigorous method, checks prior studies, drafts the study itself, hands Lyssna studies over as a ready-to-build sheet or a browser-agent prompt, runs a heuristic evaluation when an expert review is the smarter first step, and writes the finished brief into the UXR Roadmap in Notion. Requires a connected Notion MCP server.
